english.title: Obstruct person exercising a power conferred by a charging scheme in relation to an immobilised vehicle
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) intentionally obstructed **(..SPECIFY OFFICER NAME..), a person exercising a power, conferred by a charging scheme under Part III of the Transport Act 2000 and by regulations made under section 175(1) of the Act, to

(A)_[fit an immobilisation device to a]_
(B)_[fix an immobilisation notice, where an immobilisation device had been fitted, to a]_
(C)_[remove and store a]_
(D)_[release from an immobilisation device or from storage of a]_
(E)_[satisfy conditions before the release of a]_
(F)_[sell or destroy an unreleased]_

motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND REGISTRATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 175(4) and (6) of the Transport Act 2000.
